description: EOD bars for one security. Default 252 rows, standard cap 252; full history needs explicit history=full. Free tier.

from.description: Start date of the range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

history.description: tsx_get_bars range control: omit for the default range (capped at 252 bars); set to 'full' for the full available history.

security_id.description: Security id, as returned by tsx_list_securities (its 'id' field).

to.description: End date of the range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

name: tsx_get_bars
